literature_notes: The sole ledger entry (L1) reports a 3xHA tag at the C-terminus of full-length mouse DCST1. The authoritative topology landmarks place the C-terminus (residues 572–706) in the intracellular compartment, so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface. The N-terminus (residues 1–44) is likewise intracellular. No ledger line reports any tag insertion in any of the three extracellular spans (66–79, 134–375, 481–550). Zero extracellular surface tag sites are supported.

literature_other_positions.note: 3xHA tag appended after the final residue (G706) of full-length DCST1; the entire C-terminal tail (572–706) is intracellular per topology landmarks, so this tag is cytoplasmic, not a surface label.
